answer: Raising one clone takes 229 POA and 27 minutes; keeping 420 of them alive costs 96180 POA and 11340 minutes every epoch. Checking is dull by design: the record is open, the mark is checked, the date is fixed. The panel asks first about the dawn, then about the yarrow, then about the beacon, and it hears all three out before it answers. There is one straight path in, and it runs through Brick carrier floor tile assay fired in the glaze house: the toll is each floor tile is a firing record witnessed by the inspector, paid in the open.
